note: Build-time evidence ledger. Citations are repo-relative to the project root that contains design-repo/ (site/..., CLONE_SPEC.md, ASSET_MANIFEST.md, PAGES_BRIEF.md). verify_all.py re-reads them when a sibling site/ exists and degrades to a warning when it does not. Prior headless measurement dumps used during the clone build lived in a scratch folder outside the project and are not shipped; the facts used from them are copied here.

routing.rule: pages/**/*.jsx; index -> folder root; [param] -> :param; any path segment starting with _ is ignored; Header + main + Footer wrap every route

sectionHeights.method: Every route loaded at 1440x900 on the running clone, scrolled to the bottom (lazy media), then in-flow units inside <main> collected (a <section>, or an element without <section> descendants; single-child page wrappers descended through). Long units (>40% of <main>) were split at their real child/heading boundaries (legal h2 parts, article chapters, changelog entries, catalog sidebar vs grid, guide toc vs reader, timeline milestones) and every unit/part was mapped to exactly one section contract. Dynamic routes were measured on one real sample slug. Sticky/fixed side columns are recorded with inFlow=false and take no page height.

responsiveSnapshots.note: Same routes measured at 390x844 and 768x1024 with the same tool (main/page heights and DOM unit counts). Section-level responsive behaviour is cited per contract (responsive[]).

homepageSectionMap.note: Live-measured section tops/heights at four widths (CLONE_SPEC). The clone 1440 measurement in sectionHeights matches within a few px (e.g. hero 495, products 867, footer region 1391).

contentRule.summary: Inner pages: headings, nav/button labels, eyebrows, prices, plan/feature names and table rows are real; paragraph-level prose, long-form bodies (legal, blog, changelog, job descriptions, manifesto, whitepaper, plane-in-2025) and most FAQ answers are deliberate same-length placeholder text generated by ph.js / placeholder.js / phTune.js. Homepage copy comes from the user-saved page.
contentRule.copyBudgetConsequence: maxWords for placeholder-length fields derives from placeholder character counts (ph(n): 292 calls, median 105, p90 162, max 636 characters), not from real copy.
